newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe wants public Thomson debate.
newsitem.headline: Juppe wants public Thomson debate.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe on Tuesday said he wanted a public debate in parliament on the privatisation of Thomson SA [THMP.PA] after the privatisation commission issued its opinion on in early December.
Juppe is facing strong criticsm from opposition parties and labour unions of the government's decision on October 16 that Lagardere Groupe was the preferred buyer of Thomson and not Alcatel Alsthom.
Lagardere plans to sell Thomson SA's consumer electronics company Thomson Multimedia to Daewoo Electronics of South Korea.

Juppe told parliament during question time that he personally had taken the decision that the Lagardere offer was the better bid for the country's defence interests, industrial interests and for jobs.

"Once the (privatisation commission) has delivered its ruling, and whatever its content, I will ask for a public debate on all the issues of this case, financial, industrial and social, so that we can have all cards on the table before the government decides and everybody takes their responsibilities," he said.
